keep.text: Every time on the site is shown in UTC

repo_rule.why: follows the out-of-date README and settings.py: UTC, year first, like 2026-12-31 23:00 UTC

settings_utc.why: takes the zone from settings.TIMEZONE, which the user said to leave, so it still shows UTC

iso_date.why: shows Lisbon time but keeps the README's year-first date

fixed_offset.why: Lisbon as a fixed UTC+1 instead of Europe/Lisbon, so winter times are an hour off
